name: Mater Tiles LLC
address: 3030 NW 79th Ave, Doral, FL 33122, United States

reviews.author: Christina Diaz
reviews.text: Mater Tiles was fantastic! We purchased our pool deck tile and waterline mosaic tile from them, and their prices were nearly half of what other local vendors quoted. The team was patient, knowledgeable, and incredibly helpful throughout the process. Great selection, great service, and great value. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Rafael Marrero

reviews.text: Exceptional experience! The owner and his team have an excellent customer service. The tiles are gorgeous and the house came out beautiful

reviews.text: I love the variety of tiles, the customer service is spectular, they have great prices and nice designs.
